issue_context.title: re-order the initialization of `StmtCtx` fields in `(*ExecStmt).Exec`
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

In the `(a *ExecStmt) Exec`, some fields needed by the executors are not available after `buildExecutor`. Now they are shared by the same `StmtCtx` so it's fine to modify it after `buildExecutor`, but I think it's better to initialize them before `buildExecutor`.

review_comments: It's not deleted. GitHub didn't fully update the PR Diff.  https://github.com/YangKeao/tidb/blob/adjust-stmtctx-fields-init-order/pkg/executor/adapter.go looks fine.
Change base backward and forward also cannot resolve this issue :facepalm:
